title: SingPro 2.0: a proteomics-centric knowledge base for single-cell multimodal profiling.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Fetched the SingPro site (idrblab.org/singpro redirects to singpro.idrblab.net), its download page and two study pages (SCM010003, SCM010025). Each study page lists per-study files on ftp.idrblab.cn (an RNA count matrix and a protein count matrix). Every file URL I tried returned HTTP 404: HEAD, a ranged GET, and the folder itself (the server root returns 403). There is no database-wide bulk table, only per-study files and a batch download tool built on wget.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: 814 multimodal studies, ~81.5 million cells, 29 tissues, 44 diseases, 5 modalities, 12 technologies; abstract only (no PMCID, no open full text). The site itself repeats these figures plus 204 single-cell proteomics studies. I verified none of the counts.

a1_downloadable.note: Checked in the files: the listed data files (e.g. ftp.idrblab.cn/singpro2.0/SCMO/SCM010003/exp_010003_2.csv) return 404 on HEAD and on a ranged GET, for two separate studies. The links are dead as of 2026-10-06.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: From the site: each study offers only RNA and protein count matrices (cells × genes, cells × antibody tags), with no curated cell-type or outcome column. Any label (e.g. protein abundance predicted from RNA) would have to be assembled study by study across hundreds of differently formatted files.

a3_inputs_present.note: Not checked in the files. According to the site, count matrices are given directly rather than as accessions.

a4_units_stated.note: Not checked. The units are raw counts per study, and ADT (antibody-derived tag, the protein readout) panels differ across studies, so values aren't comparable without normalisation.

a5_enough_rows.note: ~81.5M cells is claimed but not verified. The real unit for generalisation is the study (814 claimed).

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: unknown; likely tens to hundreds of GB across all studies
a6_fits_laptop.note: Estimate only. Per-study subsets would fit, but the whole collection would not.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Couldn't be checked because the files didn't download.

a8_label_provenance.note: If protein counts were the label, they are a direct measurement (antibody tags read by sequencing), not a model output.

backbone.name: scGPT or Geneformer (single-cell models) would apply in principle

honest_claim_h3: Not reached: data could not be downloaded.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use gene activity (RNA) measured in single cells to predict surface protein levels in those same cells, across hundreds of studies.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-cell RNA counts from paired RNA-plus-protein single-cell studies; the number of usable cells is unknown because no file downloaded.
plain_idea.predict: Per-cell antibody-tag counts for surface proteins, measured in the same cells by CITE-seq-type assays (antibodies carrying DNA barcodes that are read by sequencing).
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Would let RNA-only single-cell atlases be annotated with likely protein levels; a cross-study test would show whether such predictions transfer between labs.

ml_idea: Cross-study prediction of surface protein levels from RNA, with whole studies held out. Considered but not pursued: the files 404, there is no bulk table, and the label would have to be harmonised across differing antibody panels.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated: no file could be downloaded to size.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Re-try one study file URL (ftp.idrblab.cn/singpro2.0/SCMO/SCM010003/exp_010003_2.csv); it returned 404 on 2026-10-06.

verdict_reason: A1 fails: the per-study data files listed on SingPro return 404 (checked for two studies), and the site has no bulk table. Even if the files worked, A2 would likely fail, because the resource is hundreds of raw per-study count matrices with no ready label column, and harmonising them would be the project.
